name: Shiraga no Judgement
source:
The emotionless disciplinary member who seeks to correct the delinquents.

The only white-haired young man on the disciplinary committee. A person whose speech and conduct lack feelings, almost as if he were a machine or doll. Like the other disciplinary members, his face is always hidden behind a white mask and he wears an exclusive and special disciplinary committee uniform.

[From [url=http://otome-jikan.net/2015/05/10/bad-apple-wars/]Otome Jikan[/url]]

[spoiler]His real name is Watase Iku (渡瀬 生).[/spoiler]
